description: In production, a sending MTA fetches https://mta-sts.example.com/.well-known/mta-sts.txt with Host: mta-sts.example.com. The handler strips port and compares the raw host case-insensitively against MtaStsDomainConfig.domain (which is documented as 'example.com', not 'mta-sts.example.com'). 'mta-sts.example.com' \!= 'example.com' → the find() always returns None → always 404. Tests pass only because they explicitly set Host: example.com, bypassing the production scenario. Fix: strip the 'mta-sts.' prefix from the Host header before comparing, or document that operators must configure domain as the full mta-sts.example.com subdomain (which contradicts the field comment and epic spec).
title: mta_sts_handler: Host mta-sts.example.com never matches domain example.com → always 404
